name: radio-group
title: RadioGroup
description: Styled Solid radio group component backed by Keystone roving selection behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-radio-group classes while Keystone keeps radiogroup semantics, roving focus, hidden radio inputs, keyboard selection, and data attributes.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers controlled and uncontrolled value state, disabled items, radiogroup ARIA, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End keyboard selection, hidden radio submission, and Mason wrapper metadata. Gaps: RTL horizontal key behavior, toolbar/nested coordination, richer label composition, form validation edge cases, and hydration edge tests remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid RadioGroup Root/Item/Input/Control/Indicator direction with single selection, hidden native inputs, disabled state, orientation, and stable data attributes. Gaps: form-control group composition, validation/reset semantics, and nested composite-widget policy remain follow-up work.
